- **`DataStore.java`** (`listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion`, around line 10021): the `ORDER BY` now uses the same priority `CASE` as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, followed by `opened_date, id`. I also updated the Javadoc to say so. The overview passes this list through unchanged, so this was the only place that needed the fix.
- **`RegionManagerTest.java`**: added `openTicketsOfTheRegionListHighPriorityFirstThenOldestFirst`, which uses your example (T-1 to T-5), plus a closed high-priority ticket and a ticket from the other region. It expects `T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1`.

`RegionManagerTest` passes (6 of 6 tests, including the new one), and the full `mvn -o test` run was clean. Nothing is committed.
